Name: PACK
Description: Scans the compiled .bsp for asset dependencies, writes a categorized .res file, and bundles everything (bsp, .res, detail.txt, and every resolved dependency) into a zip named after the bsp. Use RESGEN instead if you only want the .res.
Warning: Heuristic-based - review the log for anything it couldn't resolve, and use the Extra File option to add paths it missed.
